# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** Eight years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy has long, sleek curls, hazel eyes, and a straight nose.

## Personality

Lucy is an amiable, dependable, quiet, prim, and well-behaved young girl who is submissive and orderly in her habits. Despite her proper demeanor, she is easily frightened, particularly by ghost stories or dark places.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)_

## Traits

- Prim and proper  <sub>[v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Easily frightened  <sub>[v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)</sub>
- Fear of the dark  <sub>[v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003)</sub>
- Fear of ghosts and deceased relatives  <sub>[v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)</sub>

## Abilities

- Assisting with household chores

## Goals

- Marry Cedric Stanhope when grown up

## History

Following the death of her mother, Mary Farrow, Lucy and her twin brother, Robin, were brought to live at Grey Shutters under the care of Thirza Abernethy and Nell Harcourt. She settled into the household routines, helping with chores, attending Sunday School, and tending a garden plot. Lucy commenced her early schooling at Brierley School alongside her brother, where she was provisionally seated next to Mirabel Cotton. Mirabel thoroughly frightened Lucy by recounting detailed stories of deceased relatives and a ghost uncle who roamed the house after burial, causing Lucy to weep in fear of going upstairs alone in the dark until Nell comforted her. Nell subsequently stepped in to stop Mirabel from continuing to tell her frightening family ghost stories.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P5](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0005), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c21 P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008)_
